type: retrospective diagnostic decomposition of existing saved outputs
question: Locate the non-scalar remainder by frequency and image, and determine which measured factors accompany its decline with scale.
existing_work: stage 15 (uncommitted local analysis) is retained; no raw outputs are replaced
authorization: Saved data only. No new model inference or training. Improve the manuscript where supported and assess scientific contribution.
primary_data: Set14 14 center-240 crops, 3 models, 2 fixed trained seeds, scales 2/3/4/6; existing float16 predictions and float32 HR targets
crosschecks: DIV2K v11 aggregate statistics; existing Set14/BSD100/Urban100 original per-band response moments
primary_scope: Original 16 r bins, 0<r<0.5; Nyquist outer ring and DC audited separately

localization.image_attribution: All 14 images and negative contributions retained. Pooled-w attribution includes the per-image P-epsilon cross term; it vanishes only after pooling.
localization.heterogeneity: Top-1/top-3 shares are descriptive; leave-one-image-out refits w; training seeds are fixed, not independent image replications.
localization.energy_decomposition: J_epsilon = kappa * U, kappa=J_epsilon/U; symmetric separation of output-energy and normalized-residual changes. Inspect alignment rho=<e,epsilon>/sqrt(V*J_epsilon).

projection_diagnostics.A: One real transfer coefficient per image, seed and r band, shared across RGB
projection_diagnostics.B: Separate real coefficient per image, seed, r band and RGB channel
projection_diagnostics.C: Separate real coefficient per image, seed and Fourier frequency, shared across RGB
projection_diagnostics.D: Separate real coefficient per image, seed, Fourier frequency and RGB channel
projection_diagnostics.nesting: A->B->D and A->C->D; B and C are not nested
projection_diagnostics.interpretation: D residual is quadrature relative to native phase. Negative real coefficients can absorb pi phase flips; native-zero modes are recorded separately. Extra fitting freedom diagnoses representation limits and does not establish prediction or causal mechanism.

validation: Exact error identities, Parseval checks, old-source hash and moments crosschecks; independent numerical review. No p-hacking or new held-out claim for previously inspected images.
paper: Preserve original tracked paper in inputs/paper-before-residual-audit.tar; revise evidence and explanatory limits, compile and visually inspect the final five-page manuscript.
scientific_limits: An algebraic accounting identity is not itself a novel theory. Distinguish descriptive causes of a numerical decrease, network mechanism, and out-of-sample prediction. Do not infer conference acceptance from the analysis.

step_controls.source: Original float32 response moments: 214 images, 3 models, 2 fixed seeds, 4 scales, all 10 non-native multipliers; 51,360 records.
step_controls.primary_pairs: positive: (2,1.3333) vs (6,2), 0.01% step discrepancy; negative: (2,.75),(3,.625),(4,.5), exact h=-.25
step_controls.scope: all non-DC frequencies; separately from the retained 16-bin projection scope
step_controls.limits: Retrospective analysis after observing scale trends. Query offsets, features, native cell and support status are not controlled across scales. No causal Jacobian or new held-out claim.
step_controls.bootstrap: 2,000 paired image samples per dataset; model and trained seed fixed.
